# Jaipur Stonecraft — Comprehensive Atelier & Product Context

> Jaipur Stonecraft is an artisanal stone atelier and bespoke manufacturer located in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India, creating handcrafted sacred deity statues, architectural home mandirs, temple stonework, lattice jali screens, fountains, bas-relief murals, and custom stone creations.

## 1. Atelier Identity & Business Information
- Official Name: Jaipur Stonecraft
- Atelier Location: 30, Industrial Area, Krisna Nagar a, Kartarpura, Gopal Pura Mode, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302015, India
- Geocoordinates: Latitude 26.8924, Longitude 75.7925
- Phone & WhatsApp: +91 8690471802
- Email: Jaipurstonecraft18@gmail.com
- Official Website: https://jaipurstonecraft.com
- Operating Hours: Monday through Sunday, 08:00 – 22:00 IST (Open seven days a week, including Sunday)
- Primary Audience: Homeowners, interior architects, landscape designers, temple trusts, cultural collectors, and international overseas Indian diaspora.
- Business Model: Made-to-order bespoke craftsmanship, direct-from-atelier pricing, and custom commissions based on client dimensions and devotional requirements.

## 2. Materials & Geological Integrity
Jaipur Stonecraft works primarily with natural stones of proven architectural permanence:
- **Makrana Pure White Marble**: High-density calcite marble from Makrana, Rajasthan, with natural crystalline structure, zero artificial resin, low porosity, and excellent resilience to daily pooja care.
- **Ambaji White Marble & Sangemarmar**: Fine-grained, soft-textured white marbles ideal for delicate iconographic drapery.
- **Black Bhainslana Marble**: Dense, deep black stone quarried in Rajasthan for Shiva idols and sculptural art.
- **Pink Bansi Paharpur Sandstone**: Compact, weather-resistant pink sandstone identical to the material used in iconic Rajasthani palace and temple monuments.
- **Jodhpur Red Sandstone**: High-density quartz sandstone with rich terracotta hues for exterior columns and monumental temple gates.
- **Dholpur Beige Sandstone**: Silky, uniform beige sandstone suitable for outdoor garden fountains, seating, and balustrades.
- **Jaisalmer Yellow Limestone**: Vibrant golden fossiliferous stone for traditional jharokhas and carved floor inlays.
- **Natural Translucent Onyx**: Semi-precious banded stone used for backlit mandir backdrops and sculptural luxury accents.
- **Granite**: Offered where suitable and available for specific architectural, landscape, or structural commissions. Specific variety, color, and finish depend on project requirements and atelier confirmation.
*(Note: Jaipur Stonecraft works predominantly with natural marbles, sandstones, limestones, onyx, and select granites. Contact the atelier to review material suitability and availability for your project.)*

## 3. Product Collections & Taxonomic Structure
The atelier's catalog is organized into 6 principal collections:
1. **Sculptures & Statues** (`https://jaipurstonecraft.com/collections/sculptures-statues`):
   - Deity Idols: Ganesha, Radha Krishna, Shiva, Hanuman, Durga, Saraswati, Lakshmi, Buddha, Mahavira, and Jain Tirthankaras.
   - Sizing: Available from 12 inches (tabletop pooja altars) up to 72+ inches (life-size temple sanctum murtis).
   - Finishing: Mirror buff, natural matte, gold foil (24k leaf) embossing, and traditional colored enamel detailing.
2. **Wall Art & Relief Panels** (`https://jaipurstonecraft.com/collections/wall-art-reliefs`):
   - Bas-relief spiritual murals, narrative carvings of Ramayana and Mahabharata episodes, lotus rosettes, and backlit onyx wall features.
3. **Temples & Architectural Stonework** (`https://jaipurstonecraft.com/collections/temples-architectural-stonework`):
   - Custom-built free-standing white marble home mandirs, carved stone pillars with bracket capitals, toran entry arches, domed shikharas, and temple sanctums.
4. **Fountains & Water Features** (`https://jaipurstonecraft.com/collections/fountains-water-features`):
   - Tiered lotus fountains, lion-head wall spouts, cascading marble water walls, and sunken courtyard pools.
5. **Decorative Stone Art** (`https://jaipurstonecraft.com/collections/decorative-stone-art`):
   - Monolithic carved stone bathtubs, urli bowls with petal carvings, architectural planters, and solid marble pedestals.
6. **Custom & Bespoke Creations** (`https://jaipurstonecraft.com/collections/custom-bespoke-creations`):
   - Portrait busts from photographs, institutional commemorative statues, bespoke architectural screen walls, and custom temple restoration elements.

## 4. Craftsmanship Lineage & Quality Standards
- Proportion System: Iconographic adherence to Shilpa Shastra, Tala measurement ratios, and Vastu orientation guidelines.
- Block Selection: Acoustic sounding tests to eliminate stone blocks with hidden internal fractures or calc-silicate inclusions.
- Zero Synthetic Varnishes: Luster is achieved through sequential abrasive sanding (using carborundum and emery water buffing) yielding a permanent natural crystalline glow that never peels or yellows.
- Netra Unmilan: The final ceremonial chiseling of the deity's eyes is performed by senior master sculptors to impart a serene, living gaze (Sowmya Bhava).

## 5. Global Packing, Shipping & Inquiries
- Packaging Standard: ISPM-15 compliant heat-treated and fumigated wooden crates lined with 50mm high-density polyethylene shock foam.
- Shipping Coverage: Worldwide door delivery to the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, UAE, Europe, and domestic white-glove transport across India.
- Production Timelines & Coordination: Jaipur Stonecraft prioritizes efficient production and responsive project coordination. Turnaround times depend on the design, dimensions, customization, material availability, and special requirements. Rather than applying unverified fixed estimates, production schedules and delivery milestones are confirmed individually after reviewing the project's detailed specifications. Contact our atelier to discuss your scope and receive a project-specific timeline.
- Inquiries & Quotations: Clients can initiate requests via the website contact form (`https://jaipurstonecraft.com/contact`) or via WhatsApp (+91 8690471802) by providing desired deity/design, height dimensions, material preference, and delivery pin/postal code.
